text.p: Placer Dome Inc said on Monday it would cancel its stake in Highlands Gold Ltd in return for a 25 percent stake in the Porgera gold mine in Papua New Guinea.

In a statement from Vancouver, Placer Dome repeated a statement made earlier Monday from Sydney, replying to an independent report that showed Highlands shares to be worth 40 percent more than the 75 cent per share offered in a hostile takeover bid by Placer.
Placer currently holds about 33 percent of Highlands. Both companies hold a 25 percent stake each in Porgera.

Placer Dome chief executive officer John Willson said in the statement that Placer Dome would be prepared to buy 25 percent of Porgera for A$276.8 million, the mid-point of the brokerage Barings Burrow's valuation range.
Highlands told Reuters in Sydney that the board would review the offer over the Christmas period.
